items.title: Build a measure that rejects the wrong thing
items.subject: measurement
items.description: Ground expected behavior and distinguish instrument adequacy, local progress and parent acceptance.
items.use_when: A task needs a concrete measure or an existing measure gives misleading passes.
items.do_not_use_when: Authorizing a coder to edit protected checks or deriving truth solely from the candidate.

items.title: Scheduling checks that a plausible answer can fail
items.subject: measurement
items.description: Use concrete omitted-job, precedence, capacity and optimality counterexamples to challenge a checker.
items.use_when: Establishing that a scheduling instrument measures its stated requirements.
items.do_not_use_when: Treating finite negative controls as universal proof of checker correctness or leaking protected acceptance answers.
